method: ordinates evaluated at run time from the closed form in tensorcad.geomquality.baselines.wigley_iii -- no hand-entered numbers
notes: analytic definition, not an issuing body's tabulated ship table; used to pin the method because Cb = 4/9, Cwp = 2/3 and VCB = 5T/8 are exact
source: Wigley III parabolic hull form y = (B/2)(1-(2x/L)^2)(1-(z/T-1)^2); the standard resistance/seakeeping verification hull (Wigley 1934; Journee & Massie 2001, 'Offshore Hydromechanics', section 3)
